narrative.details:
It's been long since ye were last tested, adventurer. Ye've shown patience, aye -- but now it's time ye learned of chaos... of destruction. Fire's call is loud, and if ye're ready to pay its price, it'll speak to ye.

Seek out Bruegs Kindleborn, far east in the mountains. He dwells in a cave above South Gate Outpost. He'll know if ye're truly ready.
narrative.objectives: Find Bruegs Kindleborn in Dun Morogh.
narrative.offerRewardText: Hmm... that elder sent ye, eh? Well, a champion's word is solid, so I'll not argue. That means ye're ready for the next sapta. The sapta of fire. I see it in yer eyes already -- the burnin', the hunger. Ye've tasted power, and now ye want more. But mind yerself, Shamfor. Remember what the stone taught ye. Fire's easy to wield, but harder to master. Know when to hold back.
